text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of the code, while integration tests make sure different parts work together correctly. Many developers also use test-driven development, where they write tests before the actual code. This approach helps them think clearly about what the code should do. Good tests give developers confidence. When they change or add code, they can run the tests and quickly see if anything breaks. This saves time and reduces stress. In short, testing is not a waste of time; it is a smart habit that leads to better, safer software.
